    Endomorphisms and isomorphisms of interval representations #

    A morphism between interval representations is determined by its values on 1 at the common points. Every endomorphism of k_U is a scalar, since U is order-connected in the linear order I_*. Morphisms A j ⟶ Y and Y ⟶ P i vanish, and a morphism from Y or P j to Y is determined by its value at * (table (2.2)). Isomorphic interval representations have the same support, so the labels Y, A i, P i give pairwise nonisomorphic representations.

    φ = ψ

    Morphisms of interval representations agreeing on 1 at all common points are equal.
